title: Just for Fun Main Home | Renovated Seaside Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Just For Fun is a renovated, pet-friendly Seaside corner home with a rooftop watchtower, bikes, and a quick walk to Odessa Beach and the Westside Pool.
description_expanded: You visit Seaside "Just For Fun" but when you stay at our newly renovated home, you will fall in love with all 30A has to offer. This beautiful corner unit home is the best of location and design. Very quick 2 min walk to Odessa Beach Access and across the street from the Westside Pool. Renovated in 2024 to include an updated kitchen, new laundry room, new powder room, and updated bathrooms. This home is a stunning example of mixing retro touches with glamorous style. When you step into the home, you're reminded of the sleek styling of a teak trimmed sailboat. The 2nd floor is open and airy, with brilliant natural light bathing the main living area and tall ceilings adding to the expansive feel. Plush furniture decorates the living room including large Smart TV with Sonos. The covered balcony is a calming retreat when you want to enjoy an afternoon drink or relax with a book. A full kitchen with stainless steel appliances + dining for 6 completes the main living area. The incredible private outdoor spaces continue to a rooftop sundeck covered watchtower featuring 360 degree views of Seaside and the Gulf! Feel the Gulf breeze as you rest on the bench or lather up your sunscreen to relax on the sundeck. A family vacation isn't complete w/out your beloved pup. Just For Fun is pet friendly for non-shedding dogs 45 pounds or lighter and payment of a non-refundable pet fee. (Pet must be approved prior to arrival by Exclusive 30A. Bringing an unauthorized pet will result in fines and possible eviction without refund.) Want some extra space? Ask about adding the separate carriage house apartment with sleeping for 6 to your reservation. The main house and carriage house are rented separately, and there is a high likelihood another guest with a pet will be in the carriage house during your stay. The carriage house has a private entrance across the courtyard from the main house. ** Please note the video tour of the home does feature both the main house and carriage house. Not all areas featured in the video will be available with your reservation. Please refer to the property description to verify what is included with your stay.** Just for Fun Features - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Top Floor Watchtower with 360 views of Seaside and the Gulf - 2 Minute Walk to Odessa Beach Entrance - access to private Seaside beaches included with your reservation. - Across from the Westside Pool - the largest pool in Seaside. So close it's almost like having your own pool -Concierge services including beach chair rentals, bike rentals, grocery delivery, and baby equipment rentals available - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) -Access to Seaside Beach private entrances and all Seaside community pools included with your reservation. Some pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available; subject to change by the HOA. -Access to Seaside Tennis and Fitness included with your reservation. Schedule tennis lessons or rent court time on the Pickleball Courts - Area summer camps and kids classes available - Corner unit at the end of Odessa Street - feels very private - Complimentary Use of 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your adventures - Smart TVs throughout home including a large flat screen with Sonos in the main living room - Outdoor dining for 6 - Charcoal grill - Outdoor shower with privacy curtain - Covered front porch with rocking chairs - 2nd Floor Main Living area with high ceilings and lots of natural light - Covered balcony with outdoor dining tables, ceiling fans, and lounge chairs - Renovated 2nd Floor Kitchen - Dining table for 6 - Rooftop sundeck with loungers - New 2nd floor laundry room - Neighborhood parking for 2 vehicles in front of home - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee 3 Suites plus Loft, 3 Full Baths and 1 Powder Room, Sleeps 8 - 1st Floor King Suite 1: TV, en suite bath with large soaking tub, and walk-in shower - 1st Floor King Suite 2: TV, en suite bath with walk-in shower - 3rd Floor Guest Suite: sleeping for Two in Twin Beds, built-in dresser and closet, flat screen TV, en suite bath with walk-in shower - Loft Room: 3rd Floor Loft with sleeping for 2 in twin beds, bean bag chairs, TV, ladder entrance to loft, curtains for privacy ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
